scope: Phase B community mods plus the separately approved potion and enchanted-book resource packs

artifacts.name: AmbientSounds
artifacts.dependency: CreativeCore 2.12.36 or newer. The installed 2.12.40 artifact satisfies this requirement

artifacts.name: Block Runner
artifacts.dependency: Puzzles Lib 8.0.0 or newer. The installed 8.1.33 artifact is shared with Visual Workbench

artifacts.name: Immersive Storms Forge Port
artifacts.audit: Common registration is dedicated-server safe in static bytecode review. Client initialization and the client mixin are side-gated. The beta port is new and has no JEM runtime acceptance yet
artifacts.dependency: Cloth Config 11.1.136 or newer on the client. The exact required version is installed

artifacts.name: Backported Spears
artifacts.audit: One installation supplies the Video 2 and Video 3 requirement

artifacts.name: Visual Workbench
artifacts.dependency: Uses the installed Puzzles Lib 8.1.33 artifact

artifacts.name: Bibliophilia Enchanted Books
artifacts.compatibility: Uses CIT and includes explicit support for selected modded enchantments

artifacts.name: shureee's Potions
artifacts.compatibility: CIT rules distinguish vanilla potion types. Modded potions keep their native appearance

replaced.reason: Visual Workbench owns persistent crafting-grid state. Keeping FastWorkbench's pooled recipe-result cache creates a known shift-click stale-result conflict
The Windows Internet Shortcut is not a mod artifact and must not be transferred. The matching TreeChop JAR remains installed on client and server

configuration.ambientsounds: Overall volume 0.4 and offset playback disabled so ambience remains below JEM music and avoids the upstream transition issue
configuration.blockrunner: Only reviewed road blocks receive a uniform 1.15 multiplier. Broad fast-block tags and stronger default tiers are not used
configuration.windy: Subtle wind and ambient density, vanilla particle budget respected
configuration.weather_glass: 32-pixel vanilla style, normal rain and snow, light dust, external wind coupling disabled
configuration.immersive_storms: Dense fog, duplicate ambient wind sound/particles and black rain are disabled. Sandstorm rendering is reduced and carries no server damage

runtime_status: Static artifact, metadata, dependency and bytecode review complete. Minecraft launch, gameplay acceptance, shader acceptance and fresh-chunk worldgen acceptance were not performed
